format: track: length 1-64; active: 4 words, bar 1-4, bit n = step n of the bar; steps: 64 x 7 bytes hex (volume prob note param1Nr param1Val param2Nr param2Val); timing: 64 bytes hex, flam bits 0-3, shift bits 4-7 (7 = none); fine: 32 bytes hex, step 2i bits 0-3, 2i+1 bits 4-7, signed. case: settings (typ by name, or a number past prp, which is ---), track 0-6, src = content of track settings.src (null: cleared, length 16), cur = the destination now (null: cleared), out, vol = the voice needs vol on. prng: Rng(sed, typ, sty, track) state and its next draws (xorshift32). vel_table[d] = vel at -d dB.

cases.name: hat sty0 accent past length den16 var+3
prc sty0 accent past length var-1
prc sty0 only accent step 37 var+1
prc sty0 legacy bit 7 next to an accent
prc sty4 kick even den4 sed1
prc sty0 step1 user64 den6 var+1
